days.title: 島へ
days.morning: A ~3.5 h limousine from Hanoi to Cai Rong port (Van Don).
days.afternoon: A ~1.5 h fast boat to Co To; check in and rent a bicycle or e-cart.
days.evening: Wander the town and have a seafront seafood dinner.

days.title: ホンヴァンと灯台
days.morning: Sunrise at the Cau My rocks.
days.afternoon: Swim at Hong Van beach and cycle the coastal road through casuarina forest.
days.evening: Sunset over the island from Co To lighthouse.

days.title: コートーコン島
days.morning: Walk the sandbar to Co To Con at low tide.
days.afternoon: Swim on wild beaches, fish and camp.
days.evening: Grilled squid and peanut worms by the campfire.

days.title: ヴァンチャイ – バクヴァン
days.morning: Swim at fine white Van Chay beach.
days.afternoon: Bac Van beach and the national flagpole.
days.evening: Buy dried squid and peanut worms as gifts.

days.title: 本土へ戻る
days.morning: Breakfast of rice rolls with squid cake, then the boat to Cai Rong.
days.afternoon: Detour to Quan Lan island or head back to Hanoi.
